mechanistic_claim_tested: Myosin super-relaxed state is the molecular target of myosin inhibitors
key_finding: Identifies SRX state as mechanistic target in sarcomere cardiomyopathy

mechanistic_claim_tested: Load-dependent relief of LVOT obstruction drives benefit
key_finding: Aficamten cut Valsalva LVOT-G 66% (123->41 mmHg,p=0.001); <30 mmHg in 42%; NT-proBNP -85%; pVO2 +1.8
confidence_and_limitations: High for gradient effect; subgroup; short 24 wk

mechanistic_claim_tested: Symptom benefit tracks obstruction and is reversible
key_finding: HCMSQ symptom domains improved vs placebo (p<0.001); scores returned to baseline by wk38 after cessation
confidence_and_limitations: High; reversibility argues load-dependent not durable substrate change

mechanistic_claim_tested: CMI superior to beta-blocker for functional capacity
key_finding: Aficamten monotherapy > metoprolol for pVO2 (+1.9 to +3.1 mL/kg/min) regardless of prior therapy

mechanistic_claim_tested: Class effect on symptoms/function/remodeling in oHCM
key_finding: 4 RCTs/726 pts: +NYHA 36%, KCCQ +8.4, pVO2 +1.6; favourable cardiac remodelling
confidence_and_limitations: High for pooled clinical effect; 16-30 wk follow-up; no fibrosis endpoint pooled

mechanistic_claim_tested: Benefit attenuated without a gradient; biomarker gains persist
key_finding: ODYSSEY-HCM primary endpoints NOT met in nonobstructive HCM; MAVERICK/REDWOOD cohort4 showed biomarker+symptom gains
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; review-level; primary ODYSSEY report not retrieved

mechanistic_claim_tested: CMIs reduce hypercontractility but not energy deficit
key_finding: Myosin inhibitors (REDWOOD,MAVERICK) give robust biomarker improvements but do not address nHCM energy mismatch
Early chronic MYK-461 suppressed hypertrophy, myocyte disarray, fibrosis, profibrotic gene expression in MYH7-mutant mice
confidence_and_limitations: High internal validity; prevention not reversal; murine; early dosing

mechanistic_claim_tested: Does CMI reverse structural substrate on CMR
key_finding: LV mass index reduced (MD -20.01 g/m2); impact on myocardial fibrosis remains unclear
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; small pooled n; fibrosis inconclusive

mechanistic_claim_tested: CMI effect on mass and fibrosis markers
key_finding: Mavacamten reduced LV mass index (-30.8 g/m2) and some fibrosis indicators at wk30
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; abstract truncated; mass change may be load-mediated

mechanistic_claim_tested: Long-term substrate reversal on serial CMR
key_finding: 2-yr: LV mass index fell progressively; LGE mass UNCHANGED; native T1 fell; ECV rose then normalized
confidence_and_limitations: Low (single case); shows scar persists; interstitial signal mixed

key_finding: HCM driven by increased crossbridge formation + destabilized SRX off-actin state; CMIs reduce crossbridges
Myk461 reduced hypercontractile crossbridge kinetics in skinned myocardium incl cMyBPC-KO
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; ex vivo skinned fibers; mechanism not clinical

key_finding: Mavacamten: NYHA 2.5->1.4, NT-proBNP 1431->158, LVOT rest 65->12 mmHg, indexed LAESV 50.8->39.9
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; single-center; diastolic gains confounded by gradient relief

mechanistic_claim_tested: Diastolic effect of CMI vs alcohol septal ablation
key_finding: Compares diastolic parameters mavacamten vs ASA (both relieve gradient)
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; retrospective; abstract truncated; design isolates gradient-independent diastolic effect

key_finding: SEQUOIA CMR substudy (n=50): aficamten vs placebo effect on cardiac structure/function
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; n=50; 24 wk; abstract truncated at results
